title: Crosswalk Liberia 2021 districts to LISGIS 2022 boundaries

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Reviewed scope and dependencies ready for a worker claim

labels.name: type:geography
labels.description: Geographic source research, hierarchy/boundary evidence and proposals; no live mutations

body:
Raised/recorded: 2026-10-04 (America/Los_Angeles), based on verified findings in #473 .

The retained source is geoBoundaries 2021 Districts (136 source features, CC BY 3.0 IGO); #473 owns 127 subjects. The LISGIS catalog lists 2022 district boundary datasets under CC BY 4.0, but no geometry or exact crosswalk has been retained. Nine 2021 source-roster features remain outside this child’s exact subject scope.

**Acceptance (one focused PR):**
- Follow current AGENTS.md, geography handoff, worker coordination, premerge evidence review, and linked packet instructions; obtain a confirmed serialized reservation before implementation.
- Research every exact subject ID and relevant source predecessor/parent. Retain lawful originals or precise restoration instructions, whole-file hashes, retrieval dates, source vintage, territorial meaning, license/redistribution limits, neighboring granularity, reproducible findings, and positive/negative controls.
- Separate supported source/role conclusions from unresolved boundaries, parent links, and completeness. Include an evidence-quality v1 manifest, with changed-file accounting and honest reproduction limits.
- Preserve existing packet evidence, IDs, release pins, source vintages, other workers’ work and history. Geography evidence/proposals only: no core geography changes, production writes, deployment, publication, region approval, or import authorization.
- Link affected packet issues and leave unresolved follow-up work explicit. Completing this child cannot certify a region.

**Dependencies and readiness:** 2026-10-06 readiness review: #473 is complete and its predecessor evidence is merged. This bounded source-only research is ready under the normal claim checks; preserve the explicit unresolved-outcome limits recorded below. This Liberia scope owns only the 127 #473 subjects; #813 separately owns the other nine #472 subjects. Review the #473 evidence and preserve its original member/source IDs. No #474 or Mauritania ownership is transferred.

**Source references:** [LISGIS catalog and license](https://lisgis.gov.lr/open-data-license); [#473](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/473)
